text: You're looking for a high-protein vegan option that fits within your 45-minute time frame, and this Scrambled Tofu recipe checks all the boxes. With 15 grams of protein per serving, it's an excellent choice to help you meet your health goal. The recipe also incorporates beans' favorite companion, tofu, which is a great source of plant-based protein. The addition of nutritional yeast adds a cheesy flavor without the dairy, making it a satisfying and filling option for a quick and delicious meal.
